name: improve-ui
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：improve-ui。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Audit an existing product surface against its own design evidence, identify verified UI problems, and write self-contained implementation plans for another agent. Strictly read-only on product source. Use when asked to review, refine, improve, or clean up an interface without replacing its identity; investigate design-system drift; or prepare a design handoff.
